Searches for "BM Business Consulting" in Oakland, CA returned only unrelated firms (BM Consulting Services in Philadelphia, BM Business Consultancy in Kisumu, and similar) and generic directories. It may be a very small or sole-proprietor business, but I couldn't confirm that, so I haven't treated it as an individual.
